text: How hard a creature is to hit. An attack roll equal to or higher than the target's Armor Class hits.
A d20 roll plus an ability modifier (and the proficiency bonus if proficient) to resist a spell or danger. Meeting the DC succeeds.
The number a saving throw must reach: 8 + the caster's spellcasting ability modifier + proficiency bonus.
A d20 roll plus an ability modifier and the proficiency bonus, compared with the target's Armor Class.
A d20 that lands on 20 before modifiers. On an attack roll it always hits and is a critical hit: the damage dice are rolled twice.
A d20 that lands on 1 before modifiers. An attack roll with a natural 1 always misses.
A bonus from level (+2 at 1st, rising every four levels) added to attacks, saves and skills a character is trained in.
Casting a leveled spell spends a slot of that level or higher. Slots come back after a long rest.
A spell that can be cast at will, without spending a spell slot. Its damage grows at 5th, 11th and 17th level.
Some spells last only while the caster concentrates. Casting another concentration spell, or failing a CON save after taking damage, ends it.
Half of the ability score minus 10, rounded down: 10 gives +0, 16 gives +3, 8 gives -1.
A quick extra action some spells and features use. A creature gets at most one per turn.
